lines.zh: 阴山以南，黄河以北，
lines.en: South of the Yinshan Mountains, north of the Yellow River,

lines.zh: 坐落着一座“青色的城”。
lines.en: stands a city known as "the Blue City".

lines.zh: 蒙古语里，它叫呼和浩特。
lines.en: In Mongolian, its name is Hohhot.

lines.zh: 早在几十万年前，
lines.en: Hundreds of thousands of years ago,

lines.zh: 远古人类就在大窑一带打制石器。
lines.en: early humans were already making stone tools at Dayao.

lines.zh: 战国时，赵武灵王在此设云中郡，
lines.en: In the Warring States era, King Wuling of Zhao founded Yunzhong Commandery here,

lines.zh: 农耕与游牧，从此在这里交汇。
lines.en: and here farming and nomadic life began to meet.

lines.zh: 西汉，王昭君远嫁匈奴，
lines.en: In the Western Han, Wang Zhaojun married into the Xiongnu,

lines.zh: 换来汉匈之间数十年的和平。
lines.en: bringing decades of peace between the Han and the Xiongnu.

lines.zh: 她的青冢，至今静立在城南。
lines.en: Her tomb, the Green Mound, still stands south of the city.

lines.zh: 北魏的先祖，曾以盛乐为都；
lines.en: The forebears of the Northern Wei once made Shengle their capital;

lines.zh: 辽代，丰州城里建起一座白塔，
lines.en: under the Liao, a White Pagoda rose in the city of Fengzhou,

lines.zh: 千年风雨，它依然挺立。
lines.en: and after a thousand years, it still stands.

lines.zh: 1572年，阿勒坦汗在此筑城，
lines.en: In 1572, Altan Khan began building a city here,

lines.zh: 明朝赐名“归化”。
lines.en: and the Ming court named it Guihua.

lines.zh: 大召寺随之兴建，城因寺兴，
lines.en: With Dazhao Temple built, the city grew around its monasteries,

lines.zh: 人们称它“召城”。
lines.en: and people called it "the City of Temples".

lines.zh: 清代，又在东北筑起绥远城，
lines.en: In the Qing, the city of Suiyuan was built to the northeast;

lines.zh: 两城合称“归绥”。
lines.en: together, the two were called Guisui.

lines.zh: 驼队从这里出发，穿越大漠，
lines.en: Camel caravans set out from here across the desert,

lines.zh: 把茶叶与丝绸运向远方。
lines.en: carrying tea and silk to distant lands.

lines.zh: 1954年，归绥更名为呼和浩特，
lines.en: In 1954, Guisui was renamed Hohhot,

lines.zh: 成为内蒙古自治区首府。
lines.en: becoming the capital of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.

lines.zh: 今天，这里是“中国乳都”，
lines.en: Today it is known as China's "Dairy Capital",

lines.zh: 也是北方重要的云计算基地。
lines.en: and a major cloud-computing hub in the north.

lines.zh: 青城依旧。
lines.en: The Blue City endures.

lines.zh: 草原的风，从千年前吹到今天。
lines.en: The grassland wind still blows, from a thousand years ago to today.
